description: This file defines the RemindersService class that implements reminder management functionalities, such as listing and adding reminders, using EventKit in an iOS application.

classes.name: RemindersService
classes.description: A service class that manages reminders, including listing and adding reminders, via EventKit.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reminders based on provided parameters, with support for filtering by status and limiting number of results.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new reminder based on provided parameters such as title, notes, due date, and list information.

methods.name: resolveList
methods.description: Resolves a reminder list (calendar) by ID or name, or defaults to the default list.
